tweetText: The White House is urging OpenAI to delay the release of its new model, GPT 5.6, citing safety concerns. This could impact the pace of AI development and public access to advanced technologies. via TechCrunch AI

Patronus AI raised $50M to create digital worlds that stress-test AI agents, driven by high demand for their services. This funding highlights the growing need for robust AI testing solutions in the tech industry. via TechCrunch AI

Anthropic's Claude is gaining traction among paid AI users, challenging ChatGPT's dominance in the market. This shift could signal increased competition and innovation in the AI space. via TechCrunch AI

General Intuition has raised $320 million to enhance AI by using gameplay data, aiming to create agents with human-like intuition. This approach could revolutionize how AI learns and interacts in the real world. via TechCrunch AI

Databricks' ex-AI chief has unveiled Un-0, an image-generation tool that claims to reduce AI's energy costs by 1,000 times. This breakthrough could make AI more sustainable and accessible for everyone. via TechCrunch AI

Netris raised $15M in Series A funding from a16z to speed up the launch of AI neoclouds with its software for network switches. This investment could significantly enhance cloud deployment efficiency. via TechCrunch AI

Amazon is investing $13 billion in AI infrastructure in India, boosting its presence in the tech race. This move highlights the growing importance of India in the global AI landscape. via TechCrunch AI

Anthropic believes its growth is essential for creating safe AI, despite critics warning about its increasing influence. Their approach could shape the future of responsible AI development. via WIRED AI

Amazon's MGM Studios has pulled its OpenAI movie, reflecting the growing connection between AI and the film industry. This shift highlights how AI is reshaping content creation and industry dynamics. via WIRED AI
FIFA is giving teams access to an AI agent for the World Cup, sparking competition over tech. This could either balance the game or favor wealthier teams with better resources. via WIRED AI
